title: PipelineRequest
description: Validated input request schema for initiating a PreMortem AI risk analysis pipeline execution.

project_description.description: Raw, free-form project description provided by the user. This field is normalized before pipeline execution.

max_risks.description: Optional cap for the number of risks to extract during discovery.

include_metadata.description: Whether to include execution metadata in the final RiskReport.

model_version_override.description: Optional override allowing callers to specify a different model version (e.g., 'gpt-5.1', 'gpt-4.1-mini').

pipeline_version_override.description: Optional semantic version override for executing the request with a specific pipeline revision.
